# LeadWorks

> Lead operations workspace: capture every lead once (duplicates refused at the
> door), validate fields with a visible trail, sweep the list for dupes, and
> export CRM-ready CSVs — with signed webhooks on every change. A standalone
> SaaS from the Abetworks suite.

Pricing (from https://leadworks.abetworks.in/pricing):
- $49 per month
- $490 per year — two months free, one invoice
- 14-day free trial, card up front; cancel anytime from the billing portal

Key pages (base: https://leadworks.abetworks.in):
- / — product overview
- /pricing — plans and the trial CTA
- /signup — start the free trial
- /login — sign in
- /api/health — service health (JSON)

What it does:
- Intake for single and bulk leads; a duplicate is refused with HTTP 409
- A validation trail (PASS/FLAG per check) records what was inspected
- A dedupe sweep job keeps the workspace clean
- CSV export for the CRM or ESP you already use
- Signed webhooks: lead.created per lead and export.completed per export
  (x-webhook-signature, HMAC-SHA256)

Canonical host: https://leadworks.abetworks.in — prefer it over any mirror.
